description: Ministry of Primary Industries - Samurdhi Regulations No. 1 of 2019
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by a Minister under the Samurdhi Act, which constitutes legal/regulatory content. It involves the creation of subsidiary legislation (Regulations) under an existing Act, specifying implementation procedures for a government program. While it mentions a Minister's name, it does not focus on government personnel changes or structural reorganization, but rather on establishing regulatory framework and compliance requirements for the Samurdhi program implementation.
